topic: Brighton Kimani — Systems, Automation, DevOps & SRE Specialist
content: Brighton Kimani is a Systems, Automation, DevOps, and SRE Specialist based in Nairobi, Kenya, holding a BSc in Information Technology from Kirinyaga University. He builds resilient self-healing cloud infrastructure, low-footprint LLM serving pipelines, polyglot microservices, and end-to-end automation platforms that turn manual operational bottlenecks into high-velocity systems.

topic: Core Competencies: AI, LLMs, RAG Systems & Automation
content: Brighton's core AI and automation proficiencies include serving quantized GGUF LLMs with llama.cpp and Ollama Modelfiles, architecting hybrid RAG systems with SearXNG meta-search, building PyTorch chat interfaces and AIOps/AI-as-a-Service pipelines, and automating enterprise workflows and QA with UiPath, n8n, and Playwright.

topic: Core Competencies: DevOps, Cloud, SRE & Polyglot Microservices
content: Brighton's cloud and backend proficiencies include Kubernetes, Helm charts, OpenShift, AWS, Terraform infrastructure-as-code, GitOps (FluxCD and GitLab), Jenkins CI/CD, NetworkPolicy, RBAC, and DevSecOps security gates. He develops polyglot microservices and web applications in Python (FastAPI), .NET 8 Minimal APIs, Java (Spring Boot), and TypeScript/JavaScript.

topic: Experience: Glimpse Travel & Tours, Safaricom PLC & Bill Motors
content: Brighton works as a Part-Time Software Automation Engineer at Glimpse Travel & Tours (Nov 2026–Present), automating multi-tenant tourism vendor platforms and unified product catalogues. Previously, as an AI & Automations Engineer at Safaricom PLC (Oct 2025–Oct 2026), he built full-stack ITSM and onboarding automation microservices with UiPath, n8n, Playwright, and PyTorch (cutting execution from days to minutes) and delivered AIOps across OpenShift, AWS, and FluxCD. At Bill Motors (Jan 2024–Oct 2025), he engineered self-service Terraform cloud infrastructure, self-healing systems, and DevSecOps gates.

Brighton's flagship repository is kubernetes-llm-hosting-stack (deployed live in Kubernetes as ai-stack), which hosts quantized GGUF models under 4 GB RAM with hybrid RAG and SearXNG. His other public repositories are rhomes (TypeScript rental listings platform), Cybersmarter-business-system (TypeScript end-to-end business and inventory management system), and firstlight-apartment (JavaScript residential rental showcase).

ILA stands for Intelligent Lookup & Architecture, Brighton Kimani's live portfolio concierge running on Kubernetes (ai-stack). ILA combines a Python FastAPI gateway, local JSON knowledge retrieval plus .NET 8 and Spring Boot document indexing, optional SearXNG web search, and quantized Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct inference via llama.cpp.
